description: Health probe, public auth discovery, the auth session, and the /auth/me user endpoints the Mac app and the Chrome extension call. Roster: GET / and GET /health (served before routing, not listed in ALL_ENDPOINTS), GET /launch-app (pre-routing redirect), and the /auth/* namespace, all from the public + auth roster (scripts/lib/roster.mjs). Fixtures are real responses from `node server.mjs` on a temp DB, replaying each request over HTTP; tokens and passwords in fixtures are placeholders. Every token-protected endpoint declares the 401 that a request without an access token gets. Request bodies declare no required keys: the server validates them and answers 400, and a 400 fixture has to carry the body it was sent. Plugin, connector and MCP-server rows are not pinned where the fixtures cannot exemplify them (plugin directories are empty in the capture): the envelope is pinned, the row is an object with a description. Not declared in this group: the 400 for a malformed JSON body (every JSON route returns it, but a fixture carries parsed JSON), /auth/me/delete, /auth/me/audit, and /auth/mcp-connector/start and /status (no Mac or extension caller).
